He was the alter boy as the Catholic church would put it. He was -- an alter boy in my service.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Mr. Zivanovic, microphone, please. And before you proceed --

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: -- I don't know whether you still remember the question you put to Mr. Vukcevic, before this very long answer, but I would advise you to control your witness a little bit more.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: The question was whether you negotiated on behalf of the SDS with Ivan Vekic from the HDZ.

utterances.speaker: VOJISLAV VUKCEVIC
utterances.text: The answer is: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: May we see, please, 1D3251, 3251.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Vukcevic, can you see the document on the left-hand side of the screen?

utterances.speaker: VOJISLAV VUKCEVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I know when it was drafted. I've seen it many times.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Since you have told us that you were told by Professor Raskovic that there should be a decision in place on behalf of the party, is this the decision authorising you to negotiate with the HDZ?

utterances.speaker: VOJISLAV VUKCEVIC
utterances.text: Yes, this is the decision which authorised me to negotiate and to be a negotiator on behalf of the Serbian Democratic Party.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: And I can see that the decision was passed --

utterances.speaker: VOJISLAV VUKCEVIC
utterances.text: On the 23rd of August. I apologise -- or, rather, yes, on the 23rd of August, 1990.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, I would stop for today because I would show to the witness one pretty long document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Okay. Mr. Demirdjian, that one document the fifth one.

utterances.speaker: MR. DEMIRDJIAN
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honours. Although we have not objected to the first four that were brought by Dr. Vukcevic, the fifth one was not actually brought by him and I don't think this document is relevant or have any probative value. These are comments made by another witness, who has testified here for Your Honours, and this was not part of the witness's statement. They have no value, in our -- in our point of view. So perhaps Mr. Zivanovic wants to explain how he intends to use it, but at this stage we object to its admission to the 65 ter list.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Sorry. Mr. Zivanovic, we can try to settle this now or we can wait until the moment you want to --

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: -- use the document and see what happens then.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. But now I would tender this document into evidence. The document from the screen.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Okay. Okay. So that one is admitted and marked.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: 65 ter number 1D3251 will be Exhibit D182.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Okay. We do allow you to add to your 65 ter list the four documents we started with, and an we'll see what will happen with the fifth one. Court adjourned. I'm sorry. I'm sorry. Mr. Vukcevic, we stop here for the day. You will be expected to be back tomorrow morning at -- oh, I'm sorry. Thank you. Monday. You will be expected to be back on the witness-stand on Monday morning at 9.00. In the meantime, you stay -- you -- you are still a witness. You are still under oath. You remain under oath. That means that you cannot discuss your testimony with anyone and, on top of that, you can't communicate or talk to any of the parties at all. Do you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
